description: Backend-neutral P0-P8 product cases executed through a real Sage.js artifact and checked independently by the host adapter.

cases.description: The integrated root result exposes the versioned agent-first result envelope.
Brent solves cos(x)=x and the adapter independently evaluates the residual.
A bracket with no sign change fails with a stable domain code.
Every claimed scalar-root method solves the same smooth equation and is independently residual-checked.
Translating a scalar equation translates all computed roots by the same amount.
Barycentric interpolation reproduces a quadratic at an off-node point.
A clamped cubic spline reproduces a cubic and its derivative at independent off-grid points.
Every claimed cubic-spline boundary family satisfies interpolation and its independently checked endpoint equations.
A planned fourth-order finite difference agrees with the analytic derivative of sine.
Central, forward, and backward Fornberg stencils all differentiate exp with an independent analytic oracle.
A degree-14 Chebyshev series approximates exp and its derivative at independent points while retaining its honest heuristic classification.
Aberth-Ehrlich recovers three known roots; the host rematches roots and evaluates the polynomial independently.
A tightly clustered real polynomial remains backward validated while explicitly reporting ill conditioning.
Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod integrates sin on [0,pi] with an external exact oracle.
Explicit LU, QR, and Cholesky direct solves all satisfy an independently computed residual on a positive-definite system.
A dense solve is checked with a separately computed infinity-norm residual.
QR solves the same one-dimensional system at an extreme finite scale.
A singular square system fails closed and the determinant is independently zero.
Householder QR is checked independently for reconstruction and column orthogonality.
Cholesky is independently checked against A=L L-transpose and for a strictly lower representation.
Bounded Brent minimizes a convex quadratic with independent stationarity evidence.
The separately lazy cminpack Wasm reactor solves Rosenbrock least squares with finite differences; the adapter recomputes residual and stationarity.
The analytic-Jacobian cminpack path solves the same least-squares problem and is independently checked rather than trusting its status.
Optimization cancellation is a structured non-success, not an adapter exception.

Missing and corrupt optional cminpack boundaries leave automatic least squares on its validated ordinary-Python method while explicit cminpack requests return the same structured, nonleaking backend failure.
The explicit NLopt Nelder-Mead public route solves Rosenbrock, retains exact execution provenance, reuses only its own lazy cache, and does not enter automatic selection.
The explicit one-dimensional NLopt simplex route does not accept equal opposite-vertex objective values before independent stationarity can pass.
The one-dimensional NLopt simplex route converges at a zero-scale optimum without exhausting its evaluation budget.
A bounded one-dimensional Nelder-Mead solve cannot turn a point away from the exact lower-bound minimum into validated success merely by adding a large constant to the objective.
An NLopt positive stop at a mixed-curvature saddle is independently shown to admit diagonal descent and cannot become public mathematical success.
The advertised Nelder-Mead box-bound envelope validates the legitimate active-bound minimum instead of treating a one-sided optimum as indeterminate.
The first dimension above the validated 32-variable Nelder-Mead envelope is rejected during planning instead of entering native code without an independent local-minimum diagnostic.
The retired NLopt COBYLA method fails during public planning and reports the sanitizer disposition without entering native code.
Nonlinear constraints fail explicitly until a sanitizer-clean portable backend such as a future PRIMA integration is qualified.
Callback failure and cancellation after entering NLopt retain exact external-Wasm execution provenance without leaking private callback details.
Missing and corrupt optional NLopt boundaries leave automatic minimization on ordinary Python while the retained explicit Nelder-Mead method returns stable, nonleaking backend failures.
Dormand-Prince solves y'=y and is compared with the exact exponential flow.
Rosenbrock4 integrates one stiff decay timescale with an exact exponential flow and an explicit Jacobian.
The ODE-specific bounded sweep preserves item order and solves a family with independently known exponential flows.
An IVP cancellation request remains bounded and structured.
A symmetric eigensystem is checked with independent Av-lambda-v residuals.
The general dense eigensolver recovers an independently known upper-triangular spectrum.
Dense SVD recovers a diagonal matrix's singular values and satisfies the Frobenius norm identity.
FFT convolution agrees with an independent definition-level direct convolution.
The sparse CG path solves an SPD system and is independently checked by a dense residual.
The sparse power path returns the independently known dominant eigenpair of an SPD matrix.
The FFT is compared with an independent O(n^2) host DFT.
Two-pass descriptive statistics agree with definition-level host sums.
A one-sample t test agrees with definition-level statistic arithmetic and a pinned mature-reference p-value.
The versioned PCG stream matches a pinned prefix and replays exactly from its JSON-safe state.
Ordinary least squares agrees with independent centered-sum coefficients and retains bounded residual evidence.
The shared sweep scheduler preserves stable ordering, deterministic seeds, and bounded concurrency.
MATLAB intent lowers once and round-trips through all four supported code views.

Every foundational numerical operation emits exactly its reviewed language targets and round-trips without semantic drift; the 59 envelope-bound emitters reject changed bodies while four scalar-root parsers accept semantically equivalent source syntax.

The actual built MATLAB and Wolfram parsers reject six semantically unsafe numerical mappings with positioned structured syntax errors while two qualified integral forms still lower to runtime wrappers.
The built MATLAB parser preserves one-output column vectors, callback parameter row/column orientation, convolution row shape, and matrix-shaped arrayfun results across eleven executable programs.
Four Python/SciPy programs emitted by the Sage.js artifact execute in isolated CPython with NumPy/SciPy, then the Node adapter independently checks their mathematical outputs.

Failed numerical results cannot escape through short MATLAB/Wolfram value projections, and replayable expressions reject free symbols, wrong arity, nonfinite literals, parameter mismatches, and dishonest callbacks.
Portable numerical operands and generated-source envelopes reject excessive depth, node count, source bytes, and adversarial deep envelope payloads before execution.
A traced root computation produces bounded renderer-neutral plot and animation records.
Approximation, integration, linear algebra, ODE, optimization, spectral, and statistics results all emit bounded renderer-neutral plots and animations without replaying numerical callbacks.
Repeated scalar-optimization plots and animations use only retained solver evidence: no objective callback replay, no renderer errors, and bounded frames.
Seeded descriptive-statistics trials agree with independently regenerated host means.
A one-evaluation root budget stops predictably before unbounded callback work.
A user callback exception is contained as a domain result rather than escaping the adapter.
The cminpack callback boundary observes cooperative cancellation and releases every Wasm allocation.
Repeated root, solve, quadrature, FFT, and statistics work remains deterministic and independently valid.
The runtime remains usable after a contained callback failure; browser subjects additionally terminate and replace the real worker before this witness runs.
A bounded 131072-sample summary exercises a material allocation while the generic collector records wall time, sampled RSS, process high-water RSS, and artifact payload.
